mapper.select: SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.EQU_GBN AS EQU_GBN, A.EQU_NO AS EQU_NO, A.EQU_NAME AS EQU_NAME, A.SIZE AS SIZE, A.FORM AS FORM, A.MAKE_BY AS MAKE_BY, A.DIMENSION AS DIMENSION, A.INSTALL_DATE AS INSTALL_DATE, A.INSTALL_PLACE AS INSTALL_PLACE, A.DISUSE_GBN AS DISUSE_GBN FROM dbo.TEC_EQUIPMENT A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.EQU_GBN = #{EQU_GBN} ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC, A.EQU_NO
